answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 6973 Country: India Title: I have always evil thoughts while sleeping, at the time of namaz,during day time, etc. so pls pray for me and giv me some dua/ quran verses so that i can free from evil thoughts.it will better if u send the dua/verses in english typing. pls be fast for reply. Question: assalamwalikum, respected mufti sahab, I have always evil thoughts while sleeping, at the time of namaz,during day time, etc. so pls pray for me and giv me some dua/ quran verses so that i can free from evil thoughts.it will better if u send the dua/verses in english typing. pls be fast for reply. allah ahfiz Answer ID: 6973 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1015/895=L/1429) Recite the Four Quls (Surah Al-Kafiroon, Al-IKhlas, Al-Falaq and Al-Naas) with Ayatul Kursi etc while going to bed. While performing salah if you happen to feel satanic whispering, continue your salah without paying any attention to the whispering. Also, you should try to reform yourself by doing bai?ah (oath of allegiance) on the hands of any follower of Sunnah buzurg . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
